{{CharInfobox |color={{white color}} |corecolor={{night color light}} |bordercolor={{night color dark}} |name=Yuzo |jname=ユウゾウ |tmname=Yūzō |slogan=no |image=Yuzo.png |size=250px |caption=Yuzo |gender=Male |colors=yes |eyes=Blue |hair=Blue |region=[[Sinnoh]] |trainer=no |anime=yes |epnum=DP001 |epname=Following A Maiden's Voyage! |enva=[[Rich McNanna]] |java=[[Katsuyuki Konishi]] }} '''Yuzo''' (Japanese: '''ユウゾウ''' ''Yūzō'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. He is one of [[Professor Rowan]]'s four [[Professor's assistant|assistants]] who first appeared in ''[[DP001|Following A Maiden's Voyage!]]''. ==History== [[File:Professor Rowan aides.png|thumb|left|300px|Yuzo and his peers with Professor Rowan]] Yuzo debuted in ''[[DP001|Following A Maiden's Voyage!]]''. He was taking care of the {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} at the lab in [[Sandgem Town]] while Rowan was out, when a fight broke out between the {{p|Piplup}} and the {{p|Chimchar}} reserved for a beginning {{pkmn|Trainer}}. Things became even more disorganized after a {{p|Staraptor}} was accidentally attacked and it began to use {{m|Whirlwind}} inside the lab. Yuzo began to worry what Professor Rowan would say. He was going to attempt to clean the lab up when Rowan returned with the new Trainer, {{an|Dawn}}. It was revealed that his [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]] was a {{p|Starly}}, and his brother's (sister in the English dub) was a {{p|Bidoof}}. Yuzo appeared from ''[[DP088|Camping It Up!]]'' to ''[[DP091|One Team, Two Team, Red Team, Blue Team!]]'' as one of the teachers at Professor Rowan's [[Pokémon Summer Academy]]. His duties included handing everyone their [[rental Pokémon]] and refereeing several events, including the [[Pokémon Triathlon]]. In [[DPS01]], Yuzo was seen outside Professor Rowan's lab studying a {{p|Shinx}}. He was then seen bidding farewell to {{an|Dawn}} on her journey to [[Hoenn]]. ==Pokémon== ===Status unknown=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Yuzo |pkmn=Starly |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=396Starly.png |epnum=DP001 |epname=Following A Maiden's Voyage! |desc=Yuzo's {{p|Starly}} has never appeared but has only been mentioned, it is unknown if he still has it or not. When [[Professor Rowan]]'s assistants were examining a Starly and {{p|Staraptor}}, Yuzo said that he was a big fan of Starly and it was the first Pokémon he obtained on his journey, with the other assistant stating that his was a {{p|Bidoof}}.
